lines.zh: 我的爪子在玄武岩上刮出声
lines.en: My claws scrape the basalt.
I edge along with my wings half spread.
I pass the lava's edge, step by step.
My shadow wavers in the firelight.
I fold my wings through the narrow way.
I clamber down the rock face.
My tail drags behind me.
I circle the lava lake.
The heat of the stone does not bother me.
The flames gutter where I walk.
I close the distance, step by step.
I shift along the wall.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，像一块雕出来的石头
lines.en: I crouch like a carved stone.
Firelight plays on my face.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有翅膀在抖
lines.en: I hold still, only my wings shiver.

lines.zh: 我在听亚金能量的声音
lines.en: I listen to the hum of Argent.
Dust has settled thick on me.
This whole level answers to me.
My throat of stone makes no sound.
I wait for someone to take a wrong turn.
My claws dig into the rock.

lines.zh: 火盆的光照不到我这儿
lines.en: The brazier light does not reach me.
You do not look like you belong here.
I tilt my head and size you up.
Your blood is warm.
I know that look.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的那块石头是我
lines.en: That stone you crushed was part of me.

lines.zh: 我先看清你有几把武器
lines.en: First I count how many weapons you carry.
Nobody behind you.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在你头顶张开了
lines.en: My wings have opened above you.
Did you hear the stone creak?
I am between moving and not.
My stone shell has cracked.
I shift one step back.
Stone remembers pain like this.
Chips of stone clatter to the floor.
Stone dust falls off me.
I make a deep grinding sound.
I have noted that.
My claws dig into the ground.
This stone body has not broken yet.
I rise slowly.
That has no taste of Argent.
I do not eat this sort of thing.

lines.zh: 你把它举这么高做什么
lines.en: Why hold it up so high?
Argent energy is all I want.
To me, that is ash.
Keep that little thing yourself.
I do not get hungry.
Move that hand closer and it is gone.
I watch your hand, not it.
Throw it away while you can.

lines.zh: 你撞在我石头一样的身上
lines.en: You struck my stone-like body.
I have not moved out of the stone.
My wing brushes your face.
You stepped on my tail.
That hurt you more.
I brush past you.
Stone dust falls all over you.
Do not come along this wall.
I slide half a step along the wall.
You knocked a chip of stone off me.
Stone has no need of that.
I am something carved.
I have no such thought.
Here there is only hunter and prey.
I crouch back on my stone.
My heart is a piece of stone.
I have not moved a single claw.
I shut my eyes for a moment.
My wings fold back.
I turn my body away.
What falls by the fire is mine.
I turn it over with one claw.
This thing has a shine.
I grip it in my claw.
It is hot, and I do not mind.
I tuck it into a stone crack.
I sniff; nothing.
Whose it is, I do not ask.
I squeeze and it crumbles.
This is worth nothing.
You took the wrong level.
I have my eyes on you.
My wings are spread.
Your warmth cannot hide.

lines.zh: 这一层没人能活着过去
lines.en: Nobody passes this level alive.
I have come down off the stone.
You moved first.
I know your heartbeat.
The Argent will remember you.
You are on my list now.
I do not roar; I simply come.
I have your position worked out.

lines.zh: 让我看看你值不值一提
lines.en: Let me see if you are worth it.
I have lowered my head.
You will not run this time.
I'm on the beam, out of your sight.
I am waiting for you to look up.
I move from wall to wall.

lines.zh: 你走到哪儿，我都在上头
lines.en: Wherever you go, I am above.

lines.zh: 我的爪子已经离了石头
lines.en: My claws have left the stone.
I stay silent and listen.

lines.zh: 你听见翅膀的声音了吗
lines.en: Do you hear the wings?
A scraping comes from the cracks in the stone.

lines.zh: 火光照不到我在的地方
lines.en: The firelight does not reach my perch.
Looking back will not help.
I know this wall better than you.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在石板上回响
lines.en: Your steps echo off the flagstones.
You are standing at my landing spot.
I tuck my wings in tight.
I know this level well.
Two more steps and you are here.
I have endured a long wait for this.
Even the stone knows you now.
I do not intend to wait longer.

lines.zh: 我蹲在你看不见的那块突起上
lines.en: I crouch on a ledge you cannot see.
I drop from above.
My claws tear your shoulder.
Stone chips and you both fly.

lines.zh: 这一下是石头砸下来的力
lines.en: That fell with the weight of stone.
My wing knocks you down.
You backed off; I have not moved.

lines.zh: 我用石头一样的头撞你
lines.en: I ram you with my stone-hard skull.
My teeth are chisels.
Blood steams on the volcanic rock.
That was nothing.
I climb back up high.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候我早动了
lines.en: By the time you look up, I have moved.
I pin you against the stone wall.
Do not stand against the wall.
My shadow falls over you.
This level takes no one living.
The stone is creaking.
I have landed.

lines.zh: 我从雕像一样的姿态里活过来
lines.en: I come to life from a statue's pose.
A new shadow clings to the wall.
My eyes open, and the fire brightens.
I look down on this level.

lines.zh: 我的爪子扣进新的石头
lines.en: My claws take hold of new stone.
The Nether's heat is familiar.
I unfold my wings slowly.
The smell of Argent is strong here.
I slide down from the eaves.
I have chosen my perch.

lines.zh: 我守着这块石头很多年
lines.en: I have kept this stone many years.
A few new claw marks on the stone.
I move away from the lava's edge.
This level has a master now.

lines.zh: 这火跟下界的火不一样
lines.en: This fire is not the Nether's.
I am torn off the wall.
Water makes this stone body heavy.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从岩壁上震下来
lines.en: The blast shakes me off the rock.

lines.zh: 一发子弹打在我的石壳上
lines.en: A round cracks my stone shell.

lines.zh: 魔法渗进我的石头缝里
lines.en: Magic seeps into my cracks.

lines.zh: 我很久没有尝到亚金了
lines.en: I have not tasted Argent in a long while.
Lightning strikes my perch.
There is nothing under my feet.
